name: modgud-root
description: Root convenience scripts for building the Vue SPA and the in-app docs straight into the backend's wwwroot — used when you want `dotnet run` (no Docker) to serve a current frontend + docs.

scripts.build:landing: cd src/landing-page && pnpm install --prefer-offline && pnpm build
scripts.build:frontend: cd src/frontend-vue && pnpm install --prefer-offline && pnpm exec vite build --outDir ../dotnet/Modgud.Api/wwwroot --emptyOutDir
scripts.build:docs: cd docs && pnpm install --prefer-offline && pnpm exec vitepress build --config .vitepress/config.in-app.ts --outDir ../src/dotnet/Modgud.Api/wwwroot/docs
scripts.build:backend: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:docs
scripts.watch:frontend: cd src/frontend-vue && pnpm exec vite build --outDir ../dotnet/Modgud.Api/wwwroot --emptyOutDir --watch
